subject: Helpers wanted for Software Carpentry in Sac: 5/18 and 5/19

messages.author: f8f554f3c8aec296
messages.subject: Helpers wanted for Software Carpentry in Sac: 5/18 and 5/19
parts:
Hi All,

Jason Moore and I have organized a two-day, R-focused Software Carpentry workshop for State water agency scientists. It will cover shell, git, and R (including some ggplot and dplyr) using this curriculum, and will take place in downtown Sacramento on May 18th and 19th (full schedule at the link).

We need helpers for both the morning (unix shell /git) and afternoon (R! R! R!). sessions. If you're familiar with some of these tools but not Software Carpentry, you'd still make a great helper. (Especially if you want to learn more about Software Carpentry.) The workshop will mix lecture and live exercises. Helping is simple: mostly debugging syntax errors or suggesting software updates during lectures, but also answering questions during exercises. Full details on helping at this link.

Please respond to me and Jason off-list if you're interested or with any questions.

Thanks,
Jaime
